# Wild Collective

> Wild Collective (RIVER TERN CORPORATION) is a custom apparel manufacturer and corporate gifting company in Mysuru, Karnataka, India, serving businesses, institutions and event organisers across India and worldwide. It makes custom printed and embroidered T-shirts, polos, hoodies, caps, drinkware, bags, stationery, keychains and curated corporate gift sets, from low-cost bulk giveaways (from ₹4.50) to premium executive gifts.

- Address: NO.19, 2ND MAIN ROAD, 15TH CROSS, 3RD STAGE, GOKULAM, MYSURU, Mysuru (Mysore), Karnataka, 570002, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99454 21777
- Email: contact@wildcollective.store, shop@wildcollective.store
- GSTIN: 29COWPM7795E2ZT
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wildcollective.store/
- Ordering: no online cart; quotations are confirmed on WhatsApp or email. Prices are in INR.

## Corporate gifts by budget

- **Volume giveaways (Under ₹100 per piece)**: High-quantity branded giveaways that keep the per-piece cost low: keychains, badges, wrist bands, bookmarks, stickers, fridge magnets, caps, pens and jute pouches. Ideal for Conferences, trade shows, college fests, marathons, product launches and mass campaigns.
- **Everyday employee & client gifts (₹100 – ₹500 per piece)**: Useful pieces people keep using: custom T-shirts, collar polos, hoodies, sweatshirts, mugs, UV-printed bottles, diaries and backpacks. Ideal for Employee onboarding kits, festive gifting (Diwali, New Year), team offsites, dealer and channel partner gifts.
- **Premium & executive gifting (₹500 and above)**: Curated executive gift boxes, laptop bags, trolleys, umbrellas and recognition mementoes, presented and branded for high-value relationships. Ideal for CXO and VIP gifting, key client appreciation, board members, awards and long-service recognition.

## FAQ

### What does Wild Collective do?
Wild Collective is a custom merchandise and corporate gifting manufacturer based in Mysuru, Karnataka, India. We make custom printed and embroidered T-shirts, polo T-shirts, hoodies, caps, mugs, bottles, diaries, pens, bags, keychains, badges and curated corporate gift sets for businesses, institutions, events and individuals.

### Do you take orders from outside India?
Yes. Wild Collective works with businesses in India and internationally. Shipping method, courier cost, import duties and lead time are confirmed with each quotation on WhatsApp or email.

### What is the minimum order quantity?
Minimum quantities depend on the product and customization. Some items such as diaries start from 10 pieces; keychains and metal pens from 50; badges and stickers from 50–100; satin keychains from 500. Share your requirement and we will confirm the MOQ.

### How much do custom T-shirts cost?
Custom round neck T-shirts start from ₹75, collar (polo) T-shirts from ₹150, sweatshirts from ₹400 and hoodies from ₹450 per piece. The final price depends on fabric, print or embroidery method, number of colours and quantity.

### How do I get a quotation?
Choose your products, then send the quantity and branding requirement on WhatsApp (+91 99454 21777) or email contact@wildcollective.store. The Wild Collective team confirms pricing, options and order details directly.

### Which branding methods do you offer?
Screen printing, DTF and digital printing, embroidery, UV printing, laser engraving and embossing, chosen according to the product, fabric, artwork and finish you want.

### What are good corporate gift ideas for employees?
Popular employee gifts include custom hoodies and T-shirts, UV-printed bottles, branded mugs, diaries with metal pens, backpacks and complete welcome kits that combine several of these in a branded box.

### What are premium corporate gifts for clients and executives?
For key clients and leadership, Wild Collective curates executive gift boxes (diary, pen, bottle, mug, mobile stand and keychain), branded laptop bags, trolleys, umbrellas and custom recognition mementoes from ₹500 upwards.

### What are low-cost branded giveaways for events?
For events and bulk campaigns, bookmarks start from ₹4.50, paper wrist bands from ₹5.50, satin keychains from ₹15, button badges from ₹20, acrylic keychains from ₹45 and caps from ₹65 per piece.

### Can you make custom corporate gift boxes?
Yes. You can combine any products—bottle, diary, pen, mug, tote, keychain, backpack or cap—into a branded gift set. Use the gift set builder on the Corporate Gifts page and send the combination on WhatsApp for a quotation.

### Do you handle bulk corporate gifting orders for large teams?
Yes. Wild Collective produces bulk orders for companies, institutions and events, from small custom runs to large quantities, with direct manufacturer pricing.

### Do you ship corporate gifts internationally?
Yes, international corporate gifting orders are accepted. Delivery method, shipping cost, duties and timeline are quoted per order.
